query:
SELECT MAX(
                   COALESCE(
                       (SELECT MAX(seq) FROM cli_ingest_outbox WHERE session_id = $1),
                       0
                   ),
                   COALESCE(
                       (SELECT published_seq FROM cli_ingest_publisher_watermarks
                        WHERE session_id = $1),
                       0
                   )
               ) + 1 AS "seq!: i64"
